entries.0391d63b79af0f13: This business brokers the buying and selling of real estate, acts as agent for sales, and purchases properties to resell them. It also manages and operates rental housing and student housing. Brokerage and similar services are provided by Tokyu Livable, Inc. Management, operation and sublease of rental housing and student housing are carried out by Tokyu Housing Lease Co., Ltd., Gakusei Joho Center Co., Ltd. and others. Tokyu Livable, Inc. also acts as entrusted sales agent for condominiums and detached houses sold by Tokyu Corporation, which is an other related company. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥356,804 million (¥343,704 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025), the second largest of the four reportable segments. The number of brokerage transactions for buying and selling increased to 33,922 (32,918 in the previous year). Together with the recording of more development projects in real estate sales, revenue increased. The number of managed rental housing units was 151 thousand at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026.

entries.04c463a874f3447e: This business develops office buildings and commercial facilities for lease or sale, and also develops, sells and sells off condominiums for sale and rental housing. Tokyu Land Corporation and others carry out this business. Some office buildings are entrusted for management and operation to Tokyu Community Corp., and some commercial facilities are entrusted to Tokyu Land SC Management Corporation. Major facilities include Shibuya Sakura Stage and Shibuya Fukuras in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo. Condominiums for sale are developed and sold under the "BRANZ" brand, mainly in the Greater Tokyo and Kansai areas. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥397,351 million (¥346,118 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025), the largest of the four reportable segments. Leasing of offices improved, mainly in the Shibuya area, and the vacancy rate for office buildings and commercial facilities at the end of March 2026 was 0.7%. The number of condominium units recorded decreased to 899 units (1,006 units in the previous year). However, housing revenue increased due to a rise in sales to investors and others, and the business as a whole increased revenue.

entries.70cd1d3ecff0f213: Toward realizing, under its long-term vision "GROUP VISION 2030," the aim of "realizing a future in which everyone can shine vividly, true to themselves," the company is advancing its "Medium-Term Management Plan 2030" from fiscal 2025. Centered on creation of premium value capturing social themes, the company aims to build a strong and unique business portfolio combining growth potential and resilience to market fluctuations. Its 3 priority themes are "promotion of the Greater Shibuya Area strategy," "establishment of a GX business model," and "expansion of glocal business." entries.d1e223e0e0cf5489: In the Urban Development Business, Tokyu Land Corporation and others develop office buildings and commercial facilities and lease or sell them, and also handle condominiums for sale and rental housing. The Strategic Investment Business is development, operation and sale of renewable energy power generation facilities and logistics facilities, operation of real estate funds and REITs, and investment in real estate development in Indonesia, the United States and other countries. The Management and Operation Business includes management and renovation work for condominiums and buildings by Tokyu Community Co., Ltd. and others, operation of hotels, golf courses and ski resorts by Tokyu Resorts & Stays Co., Ltd. and others, and management of senior housing and other operations. The Real Estate Distribution Business includes brokerage of purchases and sales, sales agency and purchase and resale by Tokyu Livable, Inc. and others, and management of rental housing and student condominiums by Tokyu Housing Lease Corporation and others. Results as of the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026 were: a vacancy rate of 0.7% for office buildings and commercial facilities, 899 condominiums for sale recorded (1,006 in the previous fiscal year), 223 renewable energy facilities in operation with a rated capacity of 2,077 MW (before equity conversion), managed properties of 832,310 condominiums and 1,420 buildings and other properties, 151 thousand rental housing units under management, and 33,922 brokerage transactions for purchases and sales. In March 2026, the group's first data center project operated solely on renewable energy electricity generated by the group was completed in Ishikari, Hokkaido.

entries.ef79e9186427e90e: In December 1953, Tokyu Fudosan Co., Ltd. was established and took over the real estate sales business and other businesses from Tokyo Kyuko Electric Railway Co., Ltd. (now TOKYU CORPORATION). Tokyu Fudosan Co., Ltd. is the core company of the current holding company group, which became a wholly owned subsidiary through a joint share transfer on October 1, 2013.
entries.f79f9620bf0693b3: This business carries out comprehensive management and renovation work for condominiums and buildings, operates hotels, golf courses, ski resorts and senior housing, sells membership resort hotels and similar products, and carries out environmental greening. Comprehensive management and renovation work for condominiums and buildings is carried out by Tokyu Community Corp. and others. Sales agency for membership resort hotels and similar products is carried out by Tokyu Resort Corp. Operation of hotels, golf courses and ski resorts is carried out by Tokyu Resorts & Stay Co., Ltd. Operation and management of senior housing is carried out by Tokyu E-Life Design Co., Ltd. Environmental greening and landscaping are carried out by Sekisho Exterior Co., Ltd. New businesses under the in-house venture system are also included in this segment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥350,587 million (¥351,524 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025), the third largest of the four reportable segments. Management revenue increased due to stable fixed income and an increase in renovation work. However, wellness revenue decreased due to the transition of Ewell Co., Ltd. to an equity-method affiliate following the partial sale of its shares, and the business as a whole declined slightly. The number of managed properties at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 832,310 condominium units and 1,420 buildings and similar properties.
